children: Promoter Venkatchalam Arakoni Ramaswamy has sold over half a percent stake in Edelweiss Financial Services, while HDFC Asset Management Company has picked up more than half a percent shares in HEG via open market transactions on September 7.

As per the bulk deals data available on the exchanges on Monday, Venkatchalam Arakoni Ramaswamy, who has personal shareholding of 4.7 percent as of June 2026, offloaded 50 lakh shares for Rs 65.41 crore. The stake sale equivalent to 0.52 percent was sold at a price of Rs 130.83 per share.
Edelweiss Financial shares seem to have reacted to the promoter stake sale, falling 2.47 percent to Rs 132.72 amid big volumes on the NSE.
HDFC Mutual Fund buys over half a percent stake in HEG

HDFC Mutual Fund has acquired 9.93 lakh shares, representing 0.51 percent of paid-up equity, in HEG, the leading graphite electrode manufacturer, for Rs 26.44 crore. The buying price was Rs 266.21 per share.

HEG shares traded ex-demerger with effect from Monday. The stock rose 4.69 percent on the National Stock Exchange to Rs 272.2 compared to the adjusted previous close of Rs 260 for the demerger, while it was down 62 percent compared to actual previous day's closing of Rs 728.25, the pre-demerger price.
HEG separated its graphite electrode business from its advanced materials and energy operations.
Persistence Capital Fund buys 0.53% stake in GMM Pfaudle
Persistence Capital Fund I has bought 2.4 lakh shares, representing 0.53 percent of paid-up equity, in GMM Pfaudler, for Rs 29.67 crore. The purchasing price was Rs 1,236.11 per share.
GMM Pfaudler shares rallied 7.65 percent to Rs 1,235.7 amid big volumes, extending uptrend for second consecutive session.
United Shippers, the part of promoter group, sold 5 lakh shares in pharma company Kopran at Rs 234.66 per share, and 7 lakh shares at Rs 234.3 per share.
The total 2.48 percent stake sold by the promoter entity was worth Rs 28.13 crore.
RPP Infra Projects promoter sells 1.67% stake
Yagavi N A, a part of promoter group, offloaded 8.31 lakh shares, representing 1.67 percent of paid-up equity, in RPP Infra Projects for Rs 4.44 crore. The selling price was Rs 53.52 per share.
With this, Yagavi N A sold total shareholding of 7.98 percent (39,61,027 shares) since August, against 8.01 percent stake as of June 2026.

Baskaran Ganesan Abin Dinesh has bought 4.65 lakh shares in RPP Infra for Rs 2.49 crore at a price of Rs 53.58 per share, taking the total stake to 2.66 percent, while G Visalatchi has purchased 4.62 lakh shares for Rs 2.47 crore at Rs 53.5 per share, taking the total shareholding to 2.65 percent.
RPP Infra Projects shares rose 0.26 percent to Rs 54.28 on the NSE.

title: Edelweiss Financial promoter sells over half a percent stake; HDFC MF buys 0.51% stake in HEG
